summary: Implementation phase. Implements the first observation-only Runtime Introspection prototype: in-process, read-only data structures/functions exposing Runtime, Registry, Plugin, Capability, Health, Version, Governance, and RuntimeState metadata, integrated with the passive Runtime Registry (110E/110F). No CLI command yet -- pcae runtime inspect is explicitly deferred to 111C. Adds src/pcae/core/runtime_introspection.py: eight of 111A's eleven introspection objects implemented -- RegistryInfo/PluginInfo are direct type aliases of 110E/110F's RegistrySnapshot/PluginDescriptor (no duplicate dataclasses); RuntimeInfo, CapabilityInfo, HealthInfo, VersionInfo, GovernanceInfo, RuntimeStateInfo are new frozen dataclasses, each grounded in an already-existing source. SessionInfo/TaskInfo/PhaseInfo deliberately deferred, documented and tested as such. Eight functions mirror 111A's Introspection API 1:1: get_runtime(), get_registry(), get_plugins(), get_capabilities(), get_health(), get_governance(), get_state(), get_version(). get_registry()/get_plugins() proven, by direct equality tests, to delegate exactly to RuntimeRegistry.registry_health()/.list_plugins() -- no new computation. get_capabilities() enumerates the full ten-class frozen capability taxonomy (110B section 3), pairing each with declaring plugin IDs and an undeclarable flag (True for exactly execute/enforce). Registry integration never mutates, loads, instantiates, or invokes -- proven by an adversarial test registering a plugin whose manifest smuggles in a callable canary that raises if ever called, then exercising every introspection function against it with no failure. get_health() composes live registry data with frozen constants (execution_availability unavailable, current_runtime_state Observed, current_maximum_plugin_capability observe); runtime_status honestly reports not_implemented rather than fabricating a healthy claim about a Runtime with no live instance. get_state() restates 110A section 8's eight-state Runtime State Model verbatim. get_governance() reads permission_broker_foundation's status constant (never a live PermissionBroker() call) and command_path_observation.INTEGRATION_REGISTRY's length (4). Every new dataclass is frozen=True; PluginInfo inherits 110F's manifest-immutability hardening transparently. No CLI added, confirmed directly: no argparse/add_parser anywhere in the module, and no runtime-inspect/runtime_introspection reference in cli.py. Added docs/PHASE_111_RUNTIME_INTROSPECTION_PROTOTYPE.md. One 111A test updated (test_no_introspection_module_added_to_core) -- runtime_introspection.py's existence is now this phase's expected, intentional outcome rather than a premature-implementation violation. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 74 new tests (tests/test_runtime_introspection_prototype.py), covering every objective: object existence/deferral, registry integration, health/status/governance snapshots, immutability, no-CLI confirmation, 111A/110E/110F compatibility, and module isolation. Focused tests (1009), governance/autonomy group (2065), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
